teaser: The ladder gets climbed one rung at a time, no shortcuts taken. The toolbox gets packed the same way every trip, nothing forgotten. You are a 1, the number of the one who leads, set into an ISTJ frame that trusts procedure over improvisation. The 1 wants to go first and alone; the ISTJ wants to go correctly, on schedule. Put those two in one person and the question is not whether you lead — you do — but whether the method can bend fast enough to keep up with your own drive to stay ahead of it.
